title: Coherence and inside stalks of explicitly transposed module extension transitions
statement: For a ringed space X [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] and a sheaf F of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], write R_W for restriction, L_W for the extension-by-zero presheaf [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf] followed by module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], and A_W for the chosen adjunction L_W left adjoint to R_W [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact]. For W contained in W', define iota(W,W') explicitly by the inverse hom-equivalence of A_W applied to the restriction of the unit of A_W' at R_W' F, transported by overFunctorMap. Then iota(W,W) is identity; for W contained in W' contained in W'', iota(W,W') followed by iota(W',W'') equals iota(W,W''); and iota(W,top) followed by the top counit equals the W counit. For every x in W there is an O_X,x-linear isomorphism e(W,x) from F_x to the stalk of L_W R_W F [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] whose inverse is the stalk map of the W counit, and e(W,x).hom followed by the stalk of iota(W,W') equals e(W',x).hom.

source.place: Tags 00A7 (2)-(4), 00A5; adjunction naturality and triangle identities

proof.text: Apply injectivity of the chosen adjunction hom-equivalence. For equal opens the restriction transport is sectionwise identity, so the transpose is the unit, hence the transition is identity. For arbitrary nested opens transpose the transition followed by the later counit, use naturality of overFunctorMap and the right triangle identities at both opens, and obtain the general counit compatibility equation.

The chosen unit is invertible by [lem-sc-module-extension-by-zero-unit-isiso]. The right triangle identity therefore makes the restricted counit its inverse. For W contained in W′, transport and further restriction show that R_W of the W′ counit is invertible. To prove composition, transpose both candidate maps at W, cancel R_W of the W′′ counit, and apply the general counit equation twice. Specializing that equation to the top gives the required top-counit equation.

For x in W, forget the restricted counit to abelian presheaves on W. Its components are invertible because the restricted module counit is invertible. The restriction-stalk isomorphisms conjugate its stalk map to the underlying abelian stalk map of the global counit; prove this equation on germs using restrictStalkIso_hom_eq_germ and stalkFunctor_map_germ. Thus the global counit stalk map is invertible on abelian groups, and the module forgetful functor reflects this isomorphism. Define e(W,x) as the inverse of asIso of that stalk map. Its inverse formula is definitional. Cancel e(W′,x).inv in the final compatibility equation, use stalk functoriality and the general counit equation, and finish with the two hom-inv identities.

lean.statement:
theorem ModuleExtensionByZeroStalkTransitionCoherence (X : RingedSpace.{u})
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) :
    let iota := fun (W W' : Opens X) (h : W ≤ W') ↦
      ((Classical.choice (open_restriction_adjunction_exact X W).2.2.2.2).homEquiv _ _).symm
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (moduleRings X) (homOfLE h)).inv.app F ≫
        (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X) (homOfLE h)).map
          ((Classical.choice (open_restriction_adjunction_exact X W').2.2.2.2).unit.app
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X) W').obj F)) ≫
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (moduleRings X) (homOfLE h)).hom.app
          ((SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroPresheaf.{u} (moduleRings X) W' ⋙
            PresheafOfModules.sheafification.{u} (𝟙 (moduleRings X).obj)).obj
              ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X) W').obj F)))
    (∀ W : Opens X, iota W W le_rfl = 𝟙 _) ∧
    (∀ (W W' W'' : Opens X) (h : W ≤ W') (h' : W' ≤ W''),
      iota W W' h ≫ iota W' W'' h' = iota W W'' (h.trans h')) ∧
    (∀ W : Opens X,
      iota W ⊤ le_top ≫
          (Classical.choice (open_restriction_adjunction_exact X ⊤).2.2.2.2).counit.app F =
        (Classical.choice (open_restriction_adjunction_exact X W).2.2.2.2).counit.app F) ∧
    ∃ e : (∀ (W : Opens X) (x : X), x ∈ W →
        ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj F ≅
          (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj
            ((SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroPresheaf.{u} (moduleRings X) W ⋙
              PresheafOfModules.sheafification.{u} (𝟙 (moduleRings X).obj)).obj
                ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X) W).obj F)))),
      (∀ (W : Opens X) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ W),
        (e W x hx).inv =
          (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X x).map
            ((Classical.choice (open_restriction_adjunction_exact X W).2.2.2.2).counit.app
              F)) ∧
      (∀ (W W' : Opens X) (h : W ≤ W') (x : X) (hx : x ∈ W),
        (e W x hx).hom ≫ (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X x).map (iota W W' h) =
          (e W' x (h hx)).hom)
